judgments.reason: Paper reports EEG from 12 subjects wearing an HMD with smartphone on/off, matching the PHMD dataset (12 subjects, off/on events) by the same authors (Cattan, Congedo).
judgments.paper_title: The Impact of Passive Head-Mounted Virtual Reality Devices on the Quality of EEG Signals
judgments.paper_venue: HAL (Le Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe)

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the PHMD EEG data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a standard/specification extension of BIDS for EEG used to organize the data, not a paper describing the Cattan PHMD dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
